method.metric: macOS libproc rusage_info_v4 phys_footprint and resettable interval_max_phys_footprint; resident_size also recorded
method.isolation: one fresh process per engine/query/thread/round; engines/threads reverse in second round
method.baseline: engine/library startup and lazy/prepared query construction, followed by language GC; no query has executed
method.cold: one execution with result held; warm file cache, not cold disk
method.steady: five warmups by default followed by language GC, then twenty executions with immediate result release; interval peak reset per phase
method.retention: four independently executed results held, then released, then language GC; engine remains alive and retains reusable caches/slabs
method.results: peGosus native Result, DuckDB fetchall Python row list, Polars native DataFrame; all outputs <=367 rows on this fixture; validation/conversion after memory snapshots
method.limits: peGosus and DuckDB 512 MiB query/engine limits; Polars has no equivalent configured limit; no intentional trimming of reusable native allocator caches
method.interpretation: absolute footprint includes language/native-library costs; above_startup subtracts the fresh ready footprint; growth subtracts the pre-phase footprint; both include runtime/cache growth across repeated executions, not just operator payload or per-query allocation counts
method.planning: peGosus prepares once; DuckDB connection.execute plans each execution; Polars reuses a lazy plan with collect per execution
method.retention_limits: outputs are small; four-result retention does not characterize large materialized outputs, spills, or long-running convergence

validation.cross_engine: all seven outputs match across both rounds at 1 and 4 workers (84 fresh processes); float relative tolerance 1e-10, absolute 1e-7
validation.peak_counter: unit test captures a touched then released 32 MiB allocation and verifies reset
validation.go: full normal suite passes; memory-worker release/retention/GC/validation passes under race and aggressive checkptr for filter_count, group_sum, top50, group_day_sum at four workers
validation.allocator: all peGosus release/warmup/steady/release_all/gc snapshots have zero GeneralUsed and ScratchUsed
